notes_for_editor: Thin record: two sources, a map-site listing and OpenStreetMap tags. The story is about 70 words, below the usual 120-word floor, because the sources do not support more without padding. Nothing found on builder, date, agency, use or condition. The OSM 'observation' tag does not show it was a fire lookout. The 'neither source says' sentence about standing or access is an absence and has no quote. The brief's county is null; TopoZone gives Barbour County. Two more searches found nothing, and the GNIS entry for feature 134776 (linked from OSM) returned no data. Recommend holding for an Alabama Forestry Commission or USGS GNIS record before publishing.
